sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 169)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network and syndicated radio, Jane Morgan starring as *Aunt Mary* in two dramatic Beechwood serial installments (for Albers Flapjack Flour and Quick Oats), William Bendix in *Half-Time Strategy* on Father Patrick Peyton's *Family Theater*, two Westinghouse science dramatizations on *Adventures in Research* exploring the 'Ice King' of Boston and bioluminescent cold fire, and Little Jimmy Dickens on the *Grand Ole Opry* (1946–1992):
